userStories.title: Steering registry module in @archon/workflows
userStories.description: As an Archon engine, I want a process-local steering registry keyed by (runId, stepName) with live/parked/closed handles, synchronous enqueue, full-lifetime idempotency, and a synchronous last-gate close, so that operator guidance can be accepted safely while a provider turn is in flight without races against executor teardown.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/workflows/src/steering-registry.ts exists exporting NodeSteeringHandle, SteeringRegistry, getSteeringRegistry() (process singleton), and createSteeringRegistry() (isolated instances for tests); types match the contract in phase-01-start.md (QueuedOperatorMessage, AcceptedSteeringReceipt, SteeringHandlePhase, EnqueueResult, SteeringHandleSnapshot)
register() creates a live handle, resumes a parked handle with its queue intact, and replaces a closed handle for a genuinely new execution
enqueue() is synchronous: live appends in receipt order; parked returns ok:false 'not_live'; closed returns ok:false 'closed'

Every accepted message_id maps to its original receipt for the handle's entire lifetime; a duplicate id (same or different prose) returns the original receipt before phase/capacity logic and creates no second item; no message content is logged
More than 500 accepted ids still leaves the first id idempotent — no queue-depth, message-length, or accepted-id eviction exists anywhere
closeIfEmpty() synchronously closes and returns true only when the live queue is empty; returns false without mutation when items exist
drain() atomically returns and removes pending items without closing the handle and preserves accepted-id memory
park() retains queued items and blocks enqueue; resume() makes the same handle live again; close() refuses later enqueues but retains items for counting
discardRun(runId) closes, clears, and removes every handle for only that run, returning {handles, queued} counts; other runs unchanged; it never touches database state

Registry is exported via the ./steering-registry subpath in packages/workflows/package.json only — not through the workflows package root — and the new test file is appended to the package's explicit test script chain

bun test src/steering-registry.test.ts passes in packages/workflows covering: singleton vs isolated instances, register/get/unregister, receipt order and ISO receipt time, duplicate before/after drain and while parked, >500 id idempotency, closeIfEmpty semantics, non-closing drain, park/resume, re-registering a closed execution, discardRun run-scoping
cd packages/workflows && bun run type-check passes and eslint --max-warnings 0 is clean on the new files
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow phase-01-start.md 'Registry contract' section verbatim — names may follow nearby conventions but all invariants are required. Mirror the process-singleton pattern used by the workflow event emitter. Tests use no sleeps or network calls. This story is ONLY the registry module + its tests + package.json export/test-script entry; executor wiring is US-002.

userStories.title: Executor natural-boundary drain and central cancel cleanup
userStories.description: As an Archon engine, I want direct AI nodes, AI loop nodes, and prompt nodes inside loop groups to register a live steering handle while a resumable provider turn is active and drain queued guidance as one follow-up turn on the same provider session at the natural boundary, so that queued guidance steers the agent without interrupting the current turn.
acceptanceCriteria: executeNodeInternal registers (workflowRun.id, stepName) after provider/capability resolution only when sessionResume === true; providers without resume get no handle

All post-registration executor paths are under a lifecycle try/finally: AskHumanAwaitingError calls park() before pauseOnAskHuman; every other terminal path calls close() before the first awaited terminal write; finally warns with {runId, nodeId, queuedCount} only (never message text) and unregisters, skipping unregister only for a valid parked resumable pause

An outer provider-turn loop wraps the existing structured-output re-ask flow without replacing it: turn 1 uses existing prompt/resume id; guidance turns use drained messages joined verbatim with \n\n and the session id returned by the immediately prior turn; the captured result session id is reset per turn
Guidance turns remove stale resumeInteractions, force forkSession: false, rotate transcript attempt scope while preserving node occurrence id, and emit no extra node_started or steering event

Each settled turn preserves idle-timeout, Cancel dominance (nodeAbortController untouched), batchMessages flush exactly once per turn (moved inside the outer loop), credit-exhaustion and empty-output failures; usage/tokens/cost fold across all turns
Idle-timeout, Cancel, credit-exhaustion, empty output, or provider error close the handle and take the existing terminal path without draining — they are not natural boundaries

At a valid natural boundary closeIfEmpty() runs synchronously: true → break to the single node_completed path; false → if the just-ended turn returned no session id, close and fail the node with a clear resumability error BEFORE removing queued items; otherwise drain() immediately and continue the loop — with no await between closeIfEmpty()===false, the session-id decision, and drain()

executeLoopNode gains a function-level lifecycle catch/finally (none exists today): same registration, per-iteration inner turn loop where guidance turns do not consume a loop iteration, until_field/until/until_bash re-evaluated on the latest turn output, pending guidance wins the boundary even when output met a completion condition or max_iterations was reached, park before AskHuman and interactive between-iteration approval returns, close/unregister on all terminal outcomes including early helper returns
Prompt nodes inside loop groups register under their namespaced stepName and accept the route-facing id (verified in tests, no third implementation)

packages/core/src/db/workflows.ts: after the central cancelWorkflowRun transaction commits, discardRun(runId) runs in-process and logs only handle/queue counts; DB cancel never depends on registry contents; a cleanup failure cannot roll back or falsely fail a committed Cancel; an idempotent already-terminal cancel also discards a deliberately stale same-process handle; no stale-timeout reaper is added
Empty-queue execution is behaviorally identical: same calls, output, lifecycle events, batching, and usage as before

Focused executor tests pass (phase-01 'Tests first' lists): two messages accepted during turn 1 produce one turn-2 prompt in receipt order resuming turn 1's session id; guidance-turn forkSession:false and resumeInteractions dropped; structured-output re-ask on a guidance turn includes that guidance; per-turn batch flush; aggregated usage; missing-session failure before drain; Cancel/idle/credit/empty/throw never drain; AskHuman parks/refuses/resumes; loop delivery inside current iteration and at completion/max-iteration boundary; central cancel disposes live and parked handles post-commit; tests use controllable async generators/deferred promises — no sleeps or network

cd packages/workflows && bun test src/dag-executor.test.ts -t 'queued guidance' and full src/dag-executor.test.ts pass; cd packages/core && bun test src/db/workflows.test.ts -t 'steering handle cleanup' passes; type-check and eslint --max-warnings 0 clean on touched files
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase-01-start.md sections 'Direct-node executor flow', 'AI loop executor flow', 'Terminal run cleanup outside an active executor'. Work from stable code anchors in packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.ts, not line numbers. Key traps: batchMessages must flush inside the new outer turn loop (runStreamPass clears it); re-ask prompts must base on the current turn prompt not a turn-1 closure; the session id must be positively emitted by each turn; design decision 6 — missing session id with pending guidance is a node failure that leaves the queue intact. Do not add per-turn interrupt controllers, new lifecycle events, schema changes, or a stale-handle reaper.
userStories.notes: Implemented in iteration 2. Files: packages/workflows/src/dag-executor.ts (executeNodeInternal turns-loop + closeIfEmpty boundary; executeLoopNode/Inner split with LoopSteeringLifecycle, per-iteration turns loop, AskHuman/gate park+commit), packages/core/src/db/workflows.ts (discardRunSteeringHandles post-commit in both cancel paths), +15 executor and +7 db focused tests. All chains green.

userStories.title: Canonical typed send route in the server
userStories.description: As an operator, I want POST /api/workflows/runs/:runId/nodes/:nodeId/send to implement the ratified steering contract — authorizing any resolved identity, validating without altering my prose, resolving real run/node state, and synchronously enqueuing on the live handle — so that every acceptance and refusal matches the canonical nested error contract exactly.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/server/src/routes/schemas/workflow.schemas.ts adds sendWorkflowNodeBodySchema (strict: message refined trim().length>0 NOT transformed, message_id UUID, intent enum queue|send_now), sendWorkflowNodeResponseSchema (strict: success literal(true), message_id UUID, state enum queued|awaiting_send_now), steeringErrorSchema (strict nested error.code/message); z from @hono/zod-openapi; types via z.infer

Route registered via registerOpenApiRoute(createRoute({...}), handler, steeringValidationErrorHook) documenting JSON for 200/400/401/403/404/409/422; the route-scoped hook maps malformed JSON, missing/extra keys, blank-only text, invalid UUID, invalid intent to {success:false,error:{code:'invalid_request',message}}; global apiError/errorSchema/validation hook untouched

Steering auth middleware runs before OpenAPI body validation (401 beats 400 for unauthenticated gated callers); any resolved identity is allowed regardless of role/ownership; identity-less install/run allowed with operatorUserId:null matching adjacent interaction routes; no changes to retry/cancel/approve/reject/AskHuman authorization; resolveAuthContext and existing helpers used

Handler order enforced: auth → validation → load run (404) → project node state + handle inspection (no node+no handle→404; terminal run/node→409 node_finished even with stale live handle; closed handle→409; non-terminal node no handle→422 not_steerable_here; parked handle new message→422) → re-read run status with no subsequent await → construct internal message (original text, caller id, operator id|null, server receipt time) → synchronous enqueue → translate result

Duplicate accepted id replays its original 200 receipt even if the handle has since parked, causing no mutation; duplicate id with different prose never overwrites and emits at most a content-free warning with run/node/message ids
intent 'send_now' on a live generating handle is enqueued and returns state 'queued' — awaiting_send_now is never synthesized
Rejected requests never repair or unregister a stale handle; executor lifecycle cleanup owns the registry
No branch echoes or logs operator message content; no transcript row or workflow event is written by any code path in this story
No GET queue route, no undocumented caps, no unrelated authorization changes appear in the diff; steering-api-contract.md is not edited

Test matrix in api.workflow-runs.test.ts passes: actor matrix (starter/member/admin 200; identity-less 200 with null actor; gated unauthenticated 401 before malformed-body 400); validation matrix (blank/missing/extra/malformed/invalid UUID/invalid intent→400 nested; non-blank whitespace preserved verbatim); target matrix (404s, 409s, 422 detached, 422 parked, 200 live, send_now→queued); idempotency/races (order preserved, duplicate before/after drain replays first body, different-prose duplicate leaves original, duplicate replays while parked, terminal projection beats stale handle, terminal transition between lookup and re-read→409, closed-before-enqueue→409); no-mutation assertions snapshot handle before/after and assert no transcript/event writer call and unchanged run/node status for every rejection

After server tests+type-check pass, packages/web/src/lib/api.generated.d.ts regenerated via bun --filter @archon/web generate:types — port 3090 ownership checked first, server started in tracked session if needed, exactly that PID stopped; generated types contain the send schemas and no invented queue-read response
cd packages/server && bun test src/routes/api.workflow-runs.test.ts (full) passes; server and web type-check pass; eslint --max-warnings 0 clean on touched files
userStories.technicalNotes: Phase-02-server-send-and-queue-routes.md is the source of truth; mutation order is a correctness requirement, not style. Uses getSteeringRegistry() from US-001/US-002 via the ./steering-registry subpath. Avoid new mock.module pollution in tests; use the existing route-test setup and reset the registry between cases. Do not run a duplicate server on port 3090.

userStories.title: Queue composer dock in Legacy and Console shells
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a Queue composer dock in both Legacy and Console node rooms while the selected live agent node is generating, so that I can submit guidance by button or guarded shortcut, see accepted receipts in order under 'queued · n', keep typing without disturbing the current turn, and see an exact disclosure when the run is detached.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/lib/steering-dock.ts provides framework-free state/predicate/shortcut helpers (visibility table, blocked reason, sessionStorage key, header/count wording, announcement wording, shortcut detection incl. isComposing and keyCode 229) with identical semantics for both shells

Submission rules: blank-only drafts rejected locally with no request; original non-blank string sent unchanged; one in-flight request; button and shortcut share the guard; UUID stamped once per submission and reused on ambiguous-failure retry; editing creates a new id; 200 appends once by message_id in acceptance order, clears draft+pendingRetry, keeps textarea focus; replayed success never duplicates a row

Local sent receipts persist only for the mounted live room (cleared on execution change/unmount); never labelled delivered; draft + ambiguous retry id persist in sessionStorage scoped by run+namespaced node id; accepted receipts are never persisted; operator text renders as escaped React text with end elision — never Markdown/HTML/dangerouslySetInnerHTML

Pending ask/awaiting blocks send pre-transport with exact reason 'answer the agent's question first' (sibling asks don't block); blocked Queue is focusable with aria-disabled='true' (no native disabled), text-secondary, aria-describedby pointing to the visible reason; click and shortcut share the no-op guard

422 not_steerable_here replaces band/field/hint/controls with exactly: 'not steerable here · this run was started detached, so its live session is not in this process' (text-secondary, draft/retry preserved); 409/other failure preserves draft text and announces via role='alert'; terminal/unknown/cold/historical executions render no dock and never issue a request

API helpers added only: sendNodeGuidance(runId, nodeId, body) via fetchJSON in lib/api.ts (Legacy) and requestJson in experiments/console/skills/runs.ts (Console); both return the generated success type and surface nested status/code/message in a typed error; no auto-retry, no message logging; @archon/web imports no runtime values from server/workflows packages

Layout: RoomRegion stays flex column; transcript scroller flexible; full-bleed surface-elevated queue band (1px top rule, lowercase DOM header 'queued · n' with CSS uppercase + phase-label tracking + text-secondary, labelled list 'Queued messages, n', visible word 'sent' per item, internal scroll above 33vh, no delete/keep controls, never labelled 'this tab only') sits immediately above the dock outside its padded column; dock is final fixed sibling reducing transcript viewport — never overlaying rows

Composer: textarea with real label 'message to <node name or id>', sans body, surface-inset, border, medium radius, ≥56px, shell high-contrast focus ring; hint 'Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to send · this tab only' text-secondary; Queue button bordered/transparent in BOTH shells, right-aligned, ≥32px×≥84px, text-primary, visible label 'Queue', accessible name starting 'Queue' + shortcut + waiting count, aria-keyshortcuts='Meta+Enter Control+Enter'; no Stop control

Keyboard/focus/live regions: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter submits only when non-blank/not blocked/not in-flight/not composing; plain and Shift+Enter keep native newline; success keeps textarea focus; rejected send never drops focus to body; one polite role='status' per room for count changes; role='alert' for failures; no animation; incidental transitions honor prefers-reduced-motion

Mounting: Legacy dock after jump-to-latest control in NodeTranscriptPane's RoomRegion receiving runId, namespaced row.nodeId, row status, display label, and this-node pending-ask via selectVisibleNodeAskInteractions; Console in the analogous ConsoleNodeRoom position using its filtered pending-interaction data; console-isolation.test.ts updated so the new Console component file is in the positive list and imports only approved shared/request seams

Tests pass: steering-dock.test.ts (visibility table, shortcut matrix incl. IME, blank-local refusal vs verbatim non-blank send, in-flight guard, stable retry UUID/new UUID after edit, replayed-200 dedupe, ordering, sessionStorage round trip, header/accessible-name/count/singular-plural wording); ComposerDock.test.tsx + NodeTranscriptPane.test.tsx and ConsoleComposerDock.test.tsx + ConsoleNodeRoom.test.tsx covering generating-empty, accepted one/two receipts, shortcut/plain-Enter/composing behavior, focus retention, blocked aria contract, 422 disclosure with retained sessionStorage draft, terminal/historical no-dock, sibling-after-scroller mounting, band outside padded well

Visual checks captured/inspected per phase-03: Legacy panel at 460 CSS px; Console at 1440×900 (record actual panel width) plus 460px harness; no horizontal overflow/clipped Queue; ≥56px field; 33vh band cap with internal scroll; last transcript row reachable; unclipped focus rings; 4.5:1 text and 3:1 non-text contrast with text-secondary on the blocked label; reduced-motion parity

userStories.title: E2E evidence, acceptance report, and closeout
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want deterministic provider and browser tests proving the complete Story 2.1 path — guidance accepted while a real web-dispatched turn is open, visible in both shell docks, and delivered as the next prompt on the same provider session — plus an evidence-based acceptance report and clean closeout, so the story can merge with proof.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/providers/src/e2e-fake/provider.ts gains opt-in echoPrompt?: boolean in the strict scenario schema: when true it emits exactly one assistant chunk '[e2e-fake] echo: <promptOutsideDirectives>' (no resumeSessionId) or '[e2e-fake] resumed echo: <promptOutsideDirectives>' (with resumeSessionId) before the result, computed once via existing directive-stripping; doneWhenPromptIncludes still evaluates the stripped prompt; calls without echoPrompt emit identical chunks to before

provider.test.ts proves: non-resumed echo strips scenario+usage directives and returns a new session id; resumed echo uses resumed prefix and returns the supplied session id with resumed:true; echo+doneWhenPromptIncludes order is echo→E2E_LOOP_DONE→result; absent echoPrompt output unchanged; aborted delay still throws 'Query aborted'

e2e/fixtures/workflows/e2e-queue-guidance.yaml contains only the steer-me direct node on e2e-fake with a bounded first-turn delay (no echo, no early finish); e2e-queue-guidance-loop.yaml contains only the steer-loop loop node with until:E2E_LOOP_DONE and small bounded max_iterations — fixtures stay separate

e2e/lib/playwright/archon-runtime.ts seeds both fixtures into isolated ARCHON_HOME via the existing copy block; adds a web-dispatch start helper returning {runId, conversationId, codebaseId} once running; adds a tracked detached-CLI start helper returning PID/command/port/worktree handle always cleaned up through runtime cleanup; reuses existing status polling — no fixed sleeps, no untracked processes; the web dispatch setup is factored only if the helper has three real callers

e2e/ui/agent-queue-guidance.spec.ts passes for both shells on a fresh web-dispatched direct run per shell: no empty band + enabled Queue + 'this tab only' hint; plain Enter inserts newline with no request; shortcut queues directive-bearing 'first correction' showing 'queued · 1' + 'sent' + status announcement + cleared field + retained focus; button queues 'second correction' showing 'queued · 2' in order; after completion the transcript shows one node occurrence with exact resumed echo 'first correction\n\nsecond correction', no extra node_started/occurrence, no fabricated operator row/delivered badge
